officeFounding.proposal:
PROPOSAL · HOLLOW OAK BARBERS

You do the work, Dev. We answer your customers.

A website, and a front office that answers your texts, calls, emails and website chat, including when you're closed. It books people in, reminds them, asks for reviews and tells you what needs you.

What we run for Hollow Oak Barbers
01
Your website. Built, hosted and looked after by us, at no charge while you're with us.
02
The front office. An AI assistant answers texts, calls, emails and the chat on your site, in your voice, day and night. Anything that needs you comes straight to your WhatsApp or email.
03
Bookings, reminders and reviews. It books people in through your booking link, reminds them before they come, and asks happy customers for a review.
04
The monthly report. What it caught, what came in while you were closed, what it booked, and what needs you.
The guarantee

Any month the front office catches nothing you would have missed, you get your next month free. "Would have missed" means an enquiry that came in while you were closed, so it's measured against the opening hours you give us. It starts from your first full month live, and it's a credit on your next month, never a refund.

The terms, plainly
MONTHLY
£500/mo · founding rate, locked for life
COVERS
Your website and the front office. No setup fee.
TERM
Three months, then month to month.
START
On signing

If you leave, you can buy the website from us, or we take it down 30 days after your last paid month. Your content and logo are always yours.

What we need from you
—
Your opening hours, so the guarantee can be measured.
—
Your services, your booking link, and where alerts should go.
—
Your number, email and site chat pointed at the front office. We walk you through it.
—
Your logo and a few photos for the website.
Read the agreement →
About ten minutes, all on this page.
officeFounding.payment:
PAYMENT · HOLLOW OAK BARBERS

Set up the monthly payment.

£500 a month, founding rate. First month today, then the same date each month.

Card through Stripe, billed monthly in advance. Three months minimum, then month to month; after that you can end it with 30 days' written notice, as the agreement says.

We'll send you your payment link directly, within a working day. Nothing else is needed from you right now.
officeFounding.done:
DONE

Welcome, Hollow Oak Barbers.

Agreement signed, payment set up. You're a client.

What happens next
01
Sign in to your client space and answer the setup questions: opening hours, services, booking link, where alerts go. About ten minutes.
02
We build your website and set up the front office in your voice. You check both before anything goes live.
03
Go-live. Your number, email and site chat point at the front office, and the monthly report starts.

Your client space is at kaizenevol.com/portal — sign in with this email once Law has switched it on. Questions any time: law@kaizenevol.com or diego@kaizenevol.com. A copy of your signed agreement was emailed to you.
